description.zh_cn: 认识软件设置中的主题、字体、界面美化、光标和快捷键。已有满意配置时，可以直接确认继续。
description.en_us: Explore the app theme, fonts, appearance, cursor, and keyboard shortcuts. You can continue without changing settings you already like.

body.zh_cn: 点击左侧边栏的设置按钮。设置窗口会打开到“软件”分类；无需先创建项目或谱面。
body.en_us: Click Settings in the left sidebar. The window opens on the Software category; no project or beatmap is required.

prompt.zh_cn: 点击左侧边栏高亮的设置按钮。
prompt.en_us: Click the highlighted Settings button in the left sidebar.

body.zh_cn: 在“软件 → 常规”中打开主题列表，选择自动或喜欢的配色。主题会立即应用；若当前主题已经合适，可点击“知道了”。
body.en_us: Open the theme list under Software → General and choose Auto or a palette you like. It applies immediately. Use Got it if your current theme suits you.

prompt.zh_cn: 在软件设置中打开高亮的“主题”选择框。若分组折叠，请先展开“常规”。
prompt.en_us: Open the highlighted Theme control under Software. Expand General if it is collapsed.

body.zh_cn: ASCII 字体控制英文和符号。可选皮肤提供的字体，或用右侧浏览按钮选取 .ttf/.otf 文件；保持默认也可以。
body.en_us: The ASCII font controls Latin text and symbols. Choose a font from the skin or browse for a .ttf/.otf file; keeping Default is fine.

prompt.zh_cn: 查看高亮的 ASCII 字体选择框与浏览按钮。
prompt.en_us: Explore the highlighted ASCII font selector and browse button.

body.zh_cn: CJK 字体独立控制中日韩文字，可与英文字体分别选择。修改后字体图集会在安全时机重建。
body.en_us: The CJK font controls Chinese, Japanese, and Korean text independently from the Latin font. The font atlas rebuilds at a safe point after a change.

prompt.zh_cn: 查看高亮的 CJK 字体选择框；无需为了完成引导强制更换字体。
prompt.en_us: Explore the highlighted CJK font selector; you do not need to change a font you like.

body.zh_cn: “界面美化”集中提供窗口圆角、控件圆角、窗口间隙、组件间距、窗口内边距和动画过渡时间六项设置。可在同一处比较与调整，满意现有外观可直接继续。
body.en_us: Appearance includes six settings together: window and control rounding, window gaps, item spacing, window padding, and animation transition duration. Compare or adjust them here, or continue with your current look.

prompt.zh_cn: 展开“界面美化”，一次查看高亮区域内的全部六项设置。
prompt.en_us: Expand Appearance and inspect all six settings in the highlighted group.

body.zh_cn: 在“光标参数”中选择软件光标或系统光标。选择软件光标后，还可以设置大小、轨迹和烟雾效果；切回系统光标不会清空这些参数。
body.en_us: Choose a software or system cursor under Cursor. Software mode also offers size, trail, and smoke settings; switching to System keeps those values.

prompt.zh_cn: 展开“光标参数”后，设置页会定位到高亮的光标样式选项。
prompt.en_us: Expand Cursor; the settings page will reveal the highlighted cursor-style options.

body.zh_cn: 点击设置窗口左侧的“快捷键”分类。这里可以修改工具、编辑和播放操作的按键组合。
body.en_us: Click Shortcuts in the settings sidebar. You can configure bindings for tools, editing, and playback here.

prompt.zh_cn: 点击设置窗口左侧高亮的“快捷键”分类。
prompt.en_us: Click the highlighted Shortcuts category in the settings sidebar.

body.zh_cn: 以“移动工具”为例：点击当前绑定或“录制”，按下想要的组合键。Esc 取消录制；若已有合适的绑定，可点击“知道了”完成引导。
body.en_us: Use Move Tool as an example: click its binding or Record, then press your preferred key combination. Esc cancels recording. Use Got it if the existing binding suits you.

prompt.zh_cn: 在高亮的“移动工具”快捷键行录制组合键，或确认已有设置。
prompt.en_us: Record a binding in the highlighted Move Tool row, or keep the existing one.
